app_tagline: Your AI radar against phone scams
app_subtitle: Real-time AI fraud radar engineered for elderly protection | Garbathon × Google
safe_desc: No fraud indicators detected so far. Safe to continue.
suspicious_desc: Suspicious claims or urgency detected. Do not share confidential data.
scam_subtitle: Fraudsters are impersonating authority to steal money or passwords.
safe_exit_instruction: Say this line aloud to politely disconnect without fear:
safe_exit_spoken: Someone is at my door, I have to open it. I will visit the local police station in person.
alert_sent_toast: Safety message sent to your family member (Simulated)
summary_safe_verdict: No scam signs found. The call was genuine.
summary_scam_verdict: This call was verified as a malicious SCAM!
step_1: If any banking details were discussed, contact your bank branch immediately.
step_2: Dial National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 to report the fraud incident.
step_3: File an online complaint at national portal (cybercrime.gov.in).
flag_threat: Police never arrest anyone over a phone or video call.
flag_otp: Never share an OTP. Banks never ask for it on a call.
flag_money: No real officer asks you to transfer money to close a case.
flag_urgency: Scammers rush you so you cannot think.
flag_isolation: Real officers never tell you to hide this from your family.
flag_authority: Real authorities never threaten arrest over video or demands funds.
